verdict.rationale: Tilled is API-first with API keys, a sandbox environment, and test card numbers explicitly meant for automated integration testing, which supports headless/CI-style usage of the payments API. However there is no explicit CLI, no CI/CD pipeline integration guide, and no agent/automation-specific tooling documented. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/automation documentation, CLI or scriptable tooling, explicit mention of running in headless/CI pipelines.
